comparison.objective: Remove individual cooked gnocchi after they float, plate them, and turn off the burner; unlike separating dry ceramic media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed visual/state selection and slotted-spoon scooping from simulated water versus pouring a whole dry mixture and mobilizing bridged elongated media through a screen.
comparison.success_condition: Credits pieces removed within 45 seconds of floating, plated without hand contact, plus burner shutdown; candidate uses mass recovery, complete feed, washer retention, zero spill, supported-screen release, and dwell. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Although both use perforated tools to retain one material while another passes, gnocchi tests timed individual retrieval from liquid; the candidate tests orientation-dependent dry batch screening and bridge release.
